title: Codex MCP registry visibility is not ChatGPT conversation tool exposure
summary: Seeing a server in codex mcp list as enabled/OAuth does not prove that a ChatGPT conversation runtime can invoke its tools.
claims: Plugin installation, MCP authentication and conversation tool exposure are distinct gates.
rationale: CT-03 repeatedly passed registry/auth checks while new ChatGPT chats still lacked bridge_status/list_tabs.

evidence.note: Desktop chats reported only Opera tools while Codex listed local-shared-browser-pages.
